job_description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As a NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is looking for an AI Computer Engineer to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialists (NVIS) team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI factory systems in the world!

NVIDIA is looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer-focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyse, define and implement large scale AI Factory projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation while being the face to the customer.

What you will be doing:

  • Primary responsibilities will include deploying, managing, and maintaining AI infrastructure for new and existing customers.

  • Be the domain expert with customers during planning calls through implementation.

  • Handover-related documentation and perform knowledge transfers required to support customers as they begin rolling out some of the most sophisticated systems in the world!

  • Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements.
     

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 3+ years providing in-depth support and deployment services in data centers, solving problems for hardware and software products.

  • Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating System, administration, process management, package management, task scheduling, kernel management, boot procedures/troubleshooting, performance reporting/optimization/logging.

  • Knowledge and experience with Data center network products and protocols.

  • Knowledge and experience with Data center monitoring solutions.

  • Good interpersonal skills with the ability to maintain and deliver resolutions for customer-blocking issues as they arise. Excellent verbal and written English skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize/multi-task easily with limited supervision.
     

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • NVIDIA Certification like: AI Infrastructure and Operations/AI Infrastructure/AI Operations or equivalent.

  • Kubernetes Experience.

  • Experience with AI-focused hardware(GPUs) or software(Training/Inferencing).

  • Scripting/Automation tooling background

  • Industry-standard data center certifications.
     

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous manager who loves a challenge? Are you ready to become the staff member you always wanted to be? Come and be part of the best SW design team in the industry! We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

We are seeking an expert Account Manager for Sovereign AI with a consistent record of leading and winning impactful advanced Technology engagements in the Federal space. This full-time, customer-facing position requires close collaboration with NVIDIA product marketing, solution architects, developer relations, and applied engineering to drive revenue for the company through growth in assigned agencies, programs and ecosystem. The role requires a solid understanding of the Sovereign AI ecosystem and a track record of sales success with defense, government and research agencies. You have the skills to shift easily from working with C-level executives and government program managers to engineers both inside and outside the company.

What you'll be doing:

  • You will be responsible for all aspects of demand creation, co-selling, forecasting and sales leadership with end user customers, OEM's and partners.

  • Grow revenue and market share for NVIDIA Data Center products in assigned territory.

  • Be the key point of contact and relationship owner for a defined set of customers, agencies and surrounding ecosystem.

  • Build key accounts into strategic partnerships, and drive sustaining revenue.

  • Work closely with the public sector, OEMs, solution partners, ISVs, and research partners to craft and implement go-to-market plans to accelerate growth and adoption of the NVIDIA product family within your defined accounts.

  • Develop and lead successful programs and strategies to increase NVIDIA adoption, revenue and expansion.

  • Define, drive and communicate product strategy for future products and features specific to your customer's needs back into the Data Center Business Unit.

  • Promote the use of NVIDIA products and technologies to end customers and partners.

  • Ability to travel as business requirements require.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience).

  • 12+ years selling to the Federal market.

  • Direct experience working in Government account management in a business development or sales role representing systems, software, or other related data center and cloud infrastructure.

  • Shown sales success, leadership and goal achievement.

  • A history of implementing successful long term technology partnerships with government agencies.

  • Familiarity with Federal purchasing processes and vendor engagement.

  • Experience engaging US Federal account teams for internal knowledge exchange and collaboration.

  • Apply excellent listening and analytical skills, a consultative selling approach, and be highly motivated.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Specialty skills in heavy workload centric, Machine Learning and Deep Learning solutions.

  • Understanding of Acceleration, Virtualization, Cyber Security and Cloud technologies.

  • MBA is a plus

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers! We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us. If you're creative, proficient and love to make a difference, we want to hear from you!

Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) is a wide-ranging, multi-functional, integral team at NVIDIA. We sit at the crossroads of design, architecture, marketing, operations, and productization. Our contributions span from the arch stage and extend to defining final products. We architect innovative solutions for Datacenter, Server, Gaming, Robotics, Automotive, and Embedded markets. We are fast-paced, dynamic, share a sense of humor, and collaborate extensively to push the boundaries of what is possible. We do all of this with an eye on making groundbreaking, impactful market disruptions! We are seeking circuit validation engineer interns who are passionate about what they do and are committed to making a difference in the world through their inventions. This is a highly visible role responsible for productizing NVIDIA's chips into groundbreaking consumer, professional, server, mobile, and automotive solutions.

What you will be doing:

  • New Chip bring-up and characterize next generation of GPU ASICs in post-silicon.

  • Work closely with Chip designer and Board designer to ensure hardware meets design objectives and is ready of mass production.

  • Help design tools to automate product definitions, data collection, test case execution, and results analysis.

  • Analyze pre-production silicon in state-of-the-art process technologies for performance, power, yield, and quality to define the world’s fastest power-shipping products.

  • Develop post-silicon methodologies to characterize silicon features, correlate silicon behavior with simulations and provide design feedback.

  • AI-Driven Engineering: Build secure, traceable, and validated AI-assisted workflows for analysis, debug, and methodology automation, with human oversight for critical engineering judgments.

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing Master or PHD degree in Microelectronics/Electronic Engineering/Computer and Related Professionals.

  • Excellent problem solving, data analysis, collaborative, and interpersonal skills.

  • Hands-on experience with silicon bring up, frequency and power characterization, Tester to System/Simulation correlation, lab tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, DAQ).

  • Experience with Perl, C/C++, Python and matlab development, Windows and Linux OS is a plus

  • Practical hands-on experience leveraging AI tools and AI-augmented engineering workflows

  • Knowledgeable in MOSFETs, LDO, DC/DC, filters, digital design, timing analysis, fault analysis, sampling, computer architecture.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with Power Integrity and Signal integrity simulation and correlation with SCH/PCB design

  • Familiarity with RAG, AI agents, tool invocation, LLM benchmarking, and engineering workflow automation.

  • Proven record of technical innovation through shipped methods, tools, debug systems, patents, or published technical works.

job_name: Senior AI Model Test Developer, SDET
job_description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Be responsible for executing test cases to validate open-source model deployment, inference, and benchmarking on NVIDIA GPU.

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test cases and the supporting automation infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with development teams to triage issues, perform root cause analysis, verify fixes, define additional tests, and enhance test plans.

  • Investigate and leverage AI capabilities to accelerate the Quality Assurance (QA) process.

What we need to see:

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science or a related field, from a leading university

  • 5+ years of relevant work experience

  • Fluent oral and written English

  • Knowledge of LLMs and local AI applications, with familiarity with open-source inference runtimes and serving frameworks such as llama.cpp, Ollama, and vLLM.

  • Experience with model testing — accuracy, performance, or benchmarking evaluation of AI models

  • Experience in using AI development tools for test plans creation, test cases development and test cases automation

  • Comfortable working with Linux OS, with strong Shell/Python programming skills

  • Good QA sense, knowledge, and experience in software development and testing

  • Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills; a proactive, self-motivated quick learner with a passion for new technology

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience working with NVIDIA GPU is a strong plus

  • Background in parallel programming ideally is a plus

  • Experience with virtualization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenStack

We have an exciting opportunity for a talented Senior System Software Engineer to join our Automotive Team and help us develop innovative, safe, secure, and high-performance automotive systems. If you have a good understanding of System Software development, bring-up of new platforms, experience in QNX and Linux software development, any special expertise like bootloader design and development or RTOS based development, low level programming/debugging skills, we want to hear from you! Join us in creating the future of automotive technology and work in a team that is revolutionizing the industry.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design and develop safety (ISO26262) and security (ISO21434) compliant system software for NVIDIA DRIVE platform for autonomous vehicles
  • Perform development & bring-up activities for next-generation Tegra SOC hardware and Systems 
  • Architect and Design Software for different OS flavours where by SW is Unified and Scalable on DRIVE platform
  • Architect and Implement solutions to sophisticated issues & defects involving complex interactions between components partitioned across the large DRIVE Platform software stack

What we need to see:

  • BS/MS in electrical engineering, computer science, or computer engineering and more than 5 years of experience embedded systems software design and development 
  • Proven understanding of computer architecture, operating system fundamentals and Embedded SW 
  • Strong experience in one of the areas of Pre-Silicon/Bring-up activities or Bootloaders or RTOS based development or Scalable SW architectures
  • Strong Python/C/C++ programming and debugging skills
  • A strong teammate; passionate for work and self-motivated with a positive approach!


Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience in taking features from inception to the product following the Software Development Process and Hands-on experience with ISO26262 and ISO21434.
  • Hands-on experience with Bootloaders or RTOS or SoC Pre-Silicon/Bring-up.
